coordinate_spaces.disk: byte offset in the SD image
coordinate_spaces.uboot_payload: offset after the 64-byte uImage header (disk 0x300040, VA 0x05000040)
coordinate_spaces.va: address used by the code: SRAM 0xb406xxxx, DRAM physical from 0 (MMU off throughout)

stages.component: internal Boot ROM (not in any image)

function.note: ROM code is not available; its SRAM service entry 0xb4060400 is

inputs.source: SD card (controller selected by the ROM)
inputs.note: block 0 (ActBrm trailer at loader 0x1f4) is the only loader block whose code runs before bootloader.bin; how many sectors the ROM reads is not established

validation: ActBrm word-sum + 0x1234 rule holds for block 0 (actions_loader.py); whether the ROM checks it is not observed

inputs.source: MMIO 0xb01600a0 (CMU_DEVCLKEN0 in the S500 tree), bits 7 and 4
inputs.note: the value the ROM leaves; bit 7 -> code 2, bit 4 -> code 0, neither -> SRAM-signature test (codes 4/5)

outputs.value: boot code (0 on the SD0 path)

validation: none in block 0 on the SD paths

transition.how: blx r0 after the ROM read

inputs.source: SD via ROM service r9=4 (U-Boot, 6 chunks of <=128 KiB)

validation: app.bin: ActBrm checksum over 0x1f000 bytes at 0x1000 (0xb40654c8, executed: "OK")
U-Boot: big-endian size/load/entry read from the header; no magic or CRC check in any loader stage (no uImage magic, CRC polynomial or table constant in bootloader.bin/app.bin)
stages.failure: 0xb40693e0 prints "load fail to adfu" then blx 0xffff0140 (Boot ROM)

validation: 0xbc3c returns -1 -> "Error: 0xca00d001, please reburn system" and the jump is skipped

transition.registers: CPSR 0xd3 (SVC, IRQ/FIQ masked) set at entry

inputs.source: env: MMC device 1 at byte offsets 0x5000/0x25000, size 0x20000
inputs.note: no CRC-valid copy in any image; device 1 is the SD2 controller

validation: AFI magic "AFI" compared by every getter; absent magic -> boot_mode 1 (PRODUCE) -> ramboot

function.note: hush scripts in the default environment

inputs.source: mmc 0 (SD0, first enabled mmc node /mmc@b0230000), partition 1

validation: FAT name lookup is case-insensitive (fs/fat downcases both names) so uEnv.txt matches uenv.txt

value.bootargs: console=ttyS3 earlyprintk clk_ignore_unused selinux=0 loglevel=4 androidboot.dvfslevel=0x705x androidboot.bootdev=sd boot_dev=sd0

validation: legacy uImage header and data CRC for kernel and ramdisk (verify unset -> on); all pass for the shipped files

cpu_state: SCTLR.C and SCTLR.M cleared (dcache+MMU off) after flush
outer-cache (PL310) hooks are empty stubs: L2 state is whatever U-Boot left

init_sequence_r.note: Labels come from string references inside each entry; unlabelled entries are not named.

models: setenv/printf replaced by recorders; AFI getters and memcmp execute from the image

env_storage.note: Offsets are bytes on the MMC device the env driver opens; for an SD-only board that device is the second registered controller (see embedded_fdt), not the microSD card.

dram_init.rule: ram_size = AFI ddr_size if >= 8 MiB else 0x1f000000 (496 MiB)

callees.effect: SCTLR.C and SCTLR.M cleared (dcache+MMU off) after flush

owl_boot_fdt_setup.note: Arguments shown as null are stack buffers filled by the preceding strcpy/sprintf call; r1 of the bootargs helper is its mode (1 prepend, 2 append).

rows.note: mode 3 never initialises its stack buffer from bootargs before searching it; with the zeroed emulator stack the result is empty. Real output depends on stale stack contents. owl_boot_fdt_setup does not use mode 3.

autoboot.note: With bootdelay=0 the key loop still polls the console once before running bootcmd.

bi_arch_number.pattern: ldr rX,[sb] ... str rY,[rX,#0x40] within 9 instructions
bi_arch_number.conclusion: no writer found: bd is zeroed by reserve_board, so r1 = 0 unless env machid is set

normalised_functions.note: push-delimited chunks; branch immediates, in-image pointers and pc-relative load offsets masked

rows.item: decompressed kernel Image (written by the zImage decompressor)

overlaps.b: decompressed kernel Image (written by the zImage decompressor)
overlaps.why: the zImage decompressor relocates itself above its output before decompressing (arch/arm/boot/compressed/head.S)

memory_map.note: Addresses are U-Boot/Linux physical addresses (SDRAM base 0, MMU off at handoff). The decompressed Image row is where the zImage writes its output, after U-Boot has exited.
